products.name: Tennant T380AMR
products.tagline: Compact Autonomous Floor Scrubber for Narrow Aisles and Small Spaces
products.summary: Autonomous floor scrubbing designed for tight aisles and compact spaces, navigating safely around staff and customers with BrainOS AI.
products.overview: Increase productivity, maintain a high standard of cleaning, and effectively clean narrow aisles and spaces with the T380AMR, a compact robotic floor cleaning machine. This robotic floor scrubber is specifically designed for autonomous cleaning, working safely alongside employees and customers, while navigating around obstacles. The T380AMR is powered by BrainOS®, an advanced artificial intelligence and robotic technology platform, from Tennant partner Brain Corporation. Choose between two power source options: high capacity lithium-ion batteries or flooded lead acid batteries.

features.title: BrainOS® Artificial Intelligence
features.text: Advanced robotic vision and AI navigation platform ensures safe, consistent autonomous cleaning around staff and customers.

features.title: Compact Narrow-Aisle Design
features.text: 20-inch (500 mm) scrubbing path maneuvers effortlessly through narrow store aisles, doorways, and checkout lanes.

features.title: ec-H2O NanoClean® Technology
features.text: Electrically converts water into an effective cleaning solution, reducing chemical usage and environmental impact.

features.title: Intuitive Teach & Repeat Operation
features.text: Easy-to-understand controls allow staff to quickly train and run multiple consecutive cleaning routes with minimal supervision.

features.title: Optimal Water Recovery
features.text: Parabolic squeegee system delivers superior water recovery on both left and right turns, minimizing slip-and-fall hazards.

features.title: Flexible Power Options
features.text: Available with long-life high-capacity lithium-ion batteries or economical flooded lead-acid battery packs.

specs.label: Coverage Rate
specs.value: Up to 33,440 sq ft / 3,106 sq m per hr

specs.label: Run Time
specs.value: Up to 5 hrs (Lithium-Ion) / Up to 4 hrs (Lead Acid)

specs.label: Brush Down Pressure
specs.value: Up to 62 lbs / 28 kg (low), 90 lbs / 41 kg (high)

products.name: Tennant T7AMR
products.tagline: Micro-Rider Robotic Floor Scrubber for Medium and Large Facilities
products.summary: Commercial autonomous rider scrubber delivering reliable cleaning performance, intelligent obstacle avoidance, and water savings across medium to large footprints.
products.overview: The T7AMR autonomous floor scrubber delivers autonomous floor cleaning with intelligent navigation and reliable performance. Help reduce labor demands, improve operational efficiency, and conserve water and detergent with available ec-H2O NanoClean® technology. Powered by BrainOS®, an advanced artificial intelligence and robotic technology platform, the T7AMR is specifically designed for autonomous cleaning in commercial spaces, working safely alongside employees and customers.

features.title: BrainOS® Commercial Autonomy
features.text: Autonomous navigation handles dynamic real-world environments, automatically routing around pedestrians, luggage, and displays.

features.title: High-Efficiency Scrub Paths
features.text: 26-inch (650 mm) scrub path handles medium to large facilities with up to 45,760 sq ft/hr coverage.

features.title: ec-H2O NanoClean® Cleaning
features.text: Cleans without harsh chemicals, reducing detergent handling and leaving floors slip-resistant and clean.

features.title: Hygenic® Easy-Clean Tanks
features.text: Fully accessible solution and recovery tanks simplify daily rinse-out and prevent mold, bacteria, and odor buildup.

features.title: Extended Lithium-Ion Runtime
features.text: High-capacity lithium battery option delivers up to 6.5 hours of continuous scrubbing per charge.

features.title: Reporting & Fleet Management
features.text: Weekly performance reports and cellular usage metrics verify completed routes and daily cleaning coverage.

specs.label: Coverage Rate

specs.label: Run Time

products.name: Tennant T16AMR
products.tagline: Industrial Robotic Floor Scrubber for Warehouses and Logistics Hubs
products.summary: Heavy-duty industrial autonomous floor scrubber engineered for distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and large-scale industrial operations.
products.overview: The T16AMR delivers autonomous floor cleaning for industrial environments with intelligent navigation and reliable performance. Designed to reduce pre-sweeping, improve operational efficiency, and conserve water and detergent with ec-H2O NanoClean® technology. Featuring a heavy-duty scrub deck, massive 50-gallon capacity, and up to 200 lbs of brush down pressure, the T16AMR tackles the toughest industrial grime autonomously.

features.title: Heavy-Duty Industrial Scrubbing
features.text: Up to 200 lbs (91 kg) of down pressure removes stubborn grease, tire marks, and heavy manufacturing debris.

features.title: Wide 36-Inch Scrubbing Width
features.text: Cleans expansive industrial floor areas at up to 63,360 sq ft / 5,890 sq m per hour.

features.title: Integrated Pre-Sweep Hopper
features.text: Cylindrical scrub heads sweep solid debris into a 0.6 cu ft hopper while simultaneously wet-scrubbing.

features.title: High-Racking Autonomy
features.text: Equipped with multi-sensor 3D vision and LiDAR tuned for complex warehouse layouts with high rack aisles.

features.title: ec-H2O NanoClean® Option
features.text: Saves thousands of gallons of water and cuts detergent expenses across massive square footages.

features.title: Long-Life Industrial Batteries
features.text: High-capacity lithium battery pack supports multi-shift operations with up to 5.5 hours of runtime.

specs.label: Coverage Rate
specs.value: Up to 63,360 sq ft / 5,890 sq m per hr

specs.label: Run Time
specs.value: Up to 5.5 hrs (Lithium-Ion) / Up to 4 hrs (Lead Acid)
